SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.

   D. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

9. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
